method: Read entire catalog instructions and generation records; visually opened every available PNG individually with view_image. Original character sheet inspected. This is automated visual review, not trainer approval.

results.reason: Hang and both finished shoulder-rack poses are individually intelligible, but the explosive hip-driven clean is not shown: endpoints could also describe alternating curls. The wrist insertion/close-to-body rising path needed to distinguish a clean from a curl is absent. Stance also narrows between hang and rack, minor equipment continuity otherwise plausible.

results.poseChecks: Anatomy, grips and rack bell contact plausible. Original identity/clothes/logo consistent; full framing.

results.reason: Core sequence is complete and understandable: both grounded handles, first row, opposite row, stable wide foot contacts and return via initial pose. However every pose depicts chin/face lifted markedly forward while trunk is inclined, visibly extending neck rather than keeping head in line with trunk. This is a correction to the displayed technique, not a missing transition. Some torso rotation in unilateral row is visible but no gross sag or collapsing support.
results.neededPhase: Correct head/neck alignment in all three existing keyframes, gaze toward floor ahead of grounded handles, while keeping original identity and hips/feet/grounded bell positions. No extra PNG needed.
results.poseChecks: Both separate arm contractions visible, accurate two grips, grounded flat-base kettlebell support retained, body and equipment fully visible, original identity/clothes/logo consistent.

results.reason: Full movement is understandable and has required three distinct positions: initial supine, near-vertical top, partial descent clearly above floor. No missing intermediate necessary.
